```plato
// A continuous one-dimensional number with full arithmetic and total order.
// Number is the canonical instance. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real_number)
interface IReal
    inherits INumerical, IComparable, IHashable, IArithmetic, IInvertible
{
    ToNumber(x: Self): Number;

    // The non-negative square root (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_root). Precondition: x is not negative.
    Sqrt(x: Self): Self;
    // Floor and ceiling (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floor_and_ceiling_functions):
    // The largest whole value less than or equal to x.
    Floor(x: Self): Self;
    // The smallest whole value greater than or equal to x.
    Ceiling(x: Self): Self;
}
```
